verdict.rationale: Capacities publishes a versioned OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec (version 1.0.0) with an interactive reference. The developer docs carry a dated deprecation notice for the Beta API generation (discontinued September 1, 2026), point to the successor portal, and ask users to migrate. That successor portal lists a 'versioning' section among its documented topics, so the core of versioned APIs with announced deprecation is evidenced. missing for 10: an explicit general deprecation policy (notice periods, support windows, breaking-change rules), the actual content of the versioning section, independent or hands-on corroboration.
